lead.headline: Rice is still OUT and Jacobs hasn't practised — but the first win is in, 150.8 to 88.62
lead.deck: 9.9 left on the bench in Week 6; Daniels and Tuten are on bye and still in the lineup.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice is listed OUT for a third straight week, with nothing firmer than Reid's 'could return'. Josh Jacobs is off the exempt list but has not practised since August, and LaFleur calls Sunday only 'possible'. Week 6 was the first win, 150.8 to 88.62, with 9.9 on the bench — Stroud's 23.0 behind Daniels's 19.0, Worthy's 14.3 behind Garrett Wilson's 8.4, both projection calls. For Week 7, Stroud starts for Daniels and Gordon for Tuten now; Jacobs comes in only if Friday's report clears him, because Gordon's game locks before Green Bay's inactives.

doFirst.headline: Two swaps before Sunday, one decision on Friday
doFirst.deck: Stroud for Daniels; Gordon for Tuten now, Jacobs only if Friday clears him.
doFirst.note: No claims: priority never resets and nothing on the wire is a starter. Hold the Patriots D/ST and Gay.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide — the lineup is the projection lineup.

cards.headline: Week 7: Daniels and Tuten are off — Stroud and Gordon start
cards.reason: Washington and Jacksonville are on bye. Stroud at quarterback; Gordon in Tuten's slot by default. Jacobs replaces Gordon only if Friday's Packers report shows no designation — decide by Sunday 10:30, before Gordon's 11:00 kickoff.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is 30.8 below the projection lineup; Gordon starts over Jacobs by default because his game locks first.

4047365.logic: 12.7 against Gordon's 11.8 — a coin flip. He sits by default because Green Bay's 12:55 inactives come after Gordon's 11:00 kickoff, so a start-if-active card cannot execute. Swap him in only if Friday's report shows no designation after full practices; decide by Sunday 10:30.
